paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter with ferromagnets
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of FIG. 4(c)
notes: SHAFT experiment (Search for Halo Axions with Ferromagnetic Toroids) reports new measured 95% CL exclusion limits on the axion-photon coupling g_agamma for axion-like dark matter over masses 12 peV to 12 neV (1.2e-11 to 1.2e-8 eV, corresponding to 3 kHz - 3 MHz). Full limit curve is in Fig. 4(c), but only two numerical anchor points are given in text: best limit 4.0e-11 GeV^-1 at 20 peV, and ~8.8e-10 GeV^-1 near 0.7 neV (TeV transparency region). Limit roughly worsens toward higher mass as the ALP linewidth (beta^2*nu_a ~ 1e-6*nu_a) broadens. Standard halo model assumed with rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and v0 = 220 km/s.
